assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution makes every payment worldwide instant and free, so the Main KPI of 8,100,000,000 people with instant free payments is unmet. Domestic instant rails with free person-to-person transfers exist: India's UPI processed about 20 billion transactions in August 2025, keeps consumer and P2P transfers free, but introduces a 0.4% merchant charge on person-to-merchant payments above 2,000 rupees from 15 October 2026 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unified_Payments_Interface), and Brazil's Pix is studied as the reference design (https://doi.org/10.1186/s40854-026-00965-2). Mojaloop is an open-source interoperable instant-payment switch (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=mojaloop&sort=stars&per_page=8). Cross-border is the unsolved part: the BIS Nexus blueprint for linking instant systems within 60 seconds was handed in 2025 to Nexus Global Payments, incorporated by six Asian central banks, with no go-live date or pricing published (https://www.bis.org/about/bisih/topics/fmis/nexus.htm); the UPI-PayNow link carries about 3,000 transactions a month, and remittance pricing is still studied as a cost problem by corridor (https://doi.org/10.52783/ijept.213). Honest limit: building a domestic instant rail is a known, openly available answer (Mojaloop, UPI and Pix designs), and tasks that re-implement one are not new work; the open, checkable work is cross-border instant settlement at near-zero user cost and a sustainable funding model for zero fees, which UPI's new merchant charge shows is not settled.

additionalSearches.query: UPI Pix instant payment system adoption zero merchant fee (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 37 works: success of Pix (2026), lessons from Pix and UPI as digital public infrastructure, digital payments in Kenya, India, Brazil and Peru (2024). Domestic instant free P2P rails are documented in a few countries.

additionalSearches.query: cross-border instant payments interlinking Nexus BIS (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 27 works: the macro-financial trilemma of cross-border payments, ASEAN+3 QR interoperability, India cross-border barriers (2026). Interlinking is in pilot and policy stage.

247 repositories; mojaloop/mojaloop (328 stars), central-ledger active November 2026, Helm charts and the FSP interoperability API specification. An open-source domestic instant-payment switch exists.

additionalSearches.query: remittance costs average SDG target 3 percent (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 593 works on remittance cost determinants (South Asia 2026), AML effects on costs (2025) and settlement speed and cost (2026); cross-border transfers are neither free nor universally instant. The World Bank Remittance Prices page returned 403, so no average is cited.

Project concluded and handed to Nexus Global Payments, incorporated in 2025 by India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand; payments within 60 seconds in most cases; no go-live date or pricing given.

additionalSearches.query: UPI volumes, fees and international links
additionalSearches.finding: About 20 billion transactions in August 2025; P2P free; 0.4% MDR on P2M above 2,000 rupees from 15 October 2026; UPI-PayNow link about 3,000 transactions a month.
